yt.title: Liverpool vs Man United: Pochettino's First Test | FNMHQ Analysis
yt.caption:
Mauricio Pochettino's first game as Manchester United head coach is at Anfield: Liverpool v Manchester United, Sunday, Nov. 22, 10:30 AM CT. Callum Pryce and Jamie Hollis look at the table, his record against Liverpool, and what a good result looks like.

The facts
• After 10 games: Arsenal 1st (27 pts), Liverpool 4th (18 pts, W5 D3 L2), Manchester United 18th (8 pts, W1 D5 L4).
• Pochettino v Liverpool as a manager: 19 games, 3 wins, 5 draws, 11 defeats (goals 20–33).
• Liverpool 0–1 Southampton, Anfield, Sept. 21, 2013 (Lovren). Liverpool 4–1 Chelsea, Anfield, Jan. 31, 2024.
• United sacked Michael Carrick on Nov. 12 and named Pochettino a day later. He started on Wednesday, Nov. 18.

Our take (analysis, not fact): a draw at Anfield would be a good start. United's problem is draws, not defeats.

What's your score prediction? Tell us in the comments.
